spans.s: प्रग प्र-ग. See under प्र-गम् below.

प्र-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going before or in advance,
preceding; (ए), ind. early in the morning, at dawn,
at day-break (‘when the sun goes forth?’).
—प्रगे-
तन, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to the morn-
ing, to be performed in the morning, matutinal.
—प्रगे-निश, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one to whom it is night
early in the morning,’ i. e. one who is asleep early
in the morning.
—प्रगे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping
early in the morning, asleep at day-break.

प्रगा प्र-गा, cl. 2. 3. P. -गाति, -जिगाति,
गातुम्, to go forwards, proceed, go away, move.

प्रगण् प्र-गण्, cl. 10. P. -गणयति, -यितुम्,
to reckon up, calculate.

प्रगण्ड प्र-गण्ड, अस्, m. the upper part
of the arm from the elbow to the shoulder [cf.
प्र-काण्ड]; (ई), f. an outer wall or rampart.

प्रगदित प्र-गदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. गद्
with प्र), spoken, speaking, beginning to speak.
प्र-गाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.

प्रागद्य प्रागद्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र-गदिन्),
see Pāṇ.

प्रगम् प्र-गम्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -गच्-
छति (-ते), -गन्तुम्, to go forward, advance, pro-
ceed; to set out towards, start for; to stride towards,
go to; to reach, attain (Sāy. = प्राप्).

प्र-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forward, gone forth,
started; separate, apart; gone with difficulty.
—प्र-
गत-जानु, उस्, उस्, उ, or प्रगत-जानुक, अस्, ई,
अम्, having the knees far apart, bandy-legged, bow-
legged.

प्र-गम, अस्, m. the first manifestation of affec-
tion in conversation, first advance.

प्र-गमन, अम्, n. progress, advance; going
apart; the first manifestation of affection in the
[]
course of conversation; difficult progress (?); dis-
puting (?).
प्र-गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.
VIII. 4, 34
प्र-गामन्, walk, gait, step; [cf. पृथु-प्˚.]

प्र-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, setting out, being about
to depart.

प्रगयण प्र-गयण, अम्, n. a various read-
ing for प्र-गमन, q. v.

प्रगर्ज् प्र-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -गर्जति, -गर्जितुम्,
to roar; to begin to thunder.
प्र-गर्जन, अम्, n. roaring, roar; [cf. सिंह-प्˚.]
प्र-गर्जित, अम्, n. a roar, noise, din.

प्रगल्भ् प्र-गल्भ्, cl. 1. A. -गल्भते, -गल्-
भितुम्, to act with spirit or resolution, behave
resolutely, act in a determined manner, be deter-
mined; to be arrogant or proud; to be ready or
able to (with inf.).

प्र-गल्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, bold, confident; resolute,
energetic; prompt, ready; spirited, courageous, brave,
intrepid, daring; audacious, proud, arrogant; impudent,
shameless; strong, able; eminent, illustrious; mature
(as age); (अस्), m. an epithet of the fire employed
at the Jāta-karman; N. of a philosophical writer;
(आ), f. a bold or confident woman, a woman who courts
her husband's caresses, a wanton woman; a scolding
woman, shrew; an epithet of Durgā; (अम्), n. in
a spirited or determined manner, resolutely.
—प्र-
गल्भ-कुलाल, अस्, m. a skilful potter.
—प्रगल्-
भ-ता, f. or प्रगल्भ-त्व, अम्, n. boldness, con-
fidence; energy, resolution, resoluteness; audacity,
arrogance; power, eminence, consequence; per-
verseness, wilfulness.

प्र-गल्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered proud, arro-
gant; eminent, conspicuous.

1. प्र-गाण, अम्, n. (for 2. see under प्र-गै,
col. 3), access, approach; [cf. पृथु-प्˚.]

2. प्र-गाण, अम्, n. (for 1. see under प्र-गा,
col. 2), singing, song.

प्रगाह् प्र-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्,
गाढुम्, Ved. to dive into, enter, penetrate, pervade.

प्र-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, dipped into, steeped,
soaked, impregnated [cf. लवण-प्˚]; much, exces-
sive; hard, difficult; hard, firm; (अम्), n. pain,
privation, penance; (अम्), ind. much, exceedingly;
earnestly, forcibly; tightly, firmly; in due propor-
tion.
—प्रगाढ-ता, f. or प्रगाढ-त्व, अम्, n.
abundance, excessiveness; hardness.

प्र-गाहन, अम्, n., Ved. dipping or plunging
into.

प्रगुण प्र-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having excel-
lent qualities, being in a good state or condition, being
in the right state or order, straight; honest, upright.
—प्रगुणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make straight, put in order, arrange, place in
rank and file, array; to spread, make smooth or even.
प्र-गुणन, अम्, n. putting straight.

प्रगुणय, Nom. P. प्रगुणयति, -यितुम्, to
make straight.

प्र-गुणित, अस्, आ, अम्, made straight or even,
made smooth, smoothed.

प्र-गुणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, straightened, made smooth
or even, smoothed.

प्र-गुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having excellent qualities,
excellent; more, exceeding.

प्रगुप् प्र-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपयति, -यितुम्,
to seek to protect, to guard.

प्र-गोपन, अम्, n. protection, preservation,
salvation.

प्रगुर् प्र-गुर्, cl. 6. P. -गुरति, -गुरितुम्,
Ved. to cry aloud, exclaim loudly; to make great
efforts, make strenuous exertions (Sāy. = अत्यर्थम्
उद्युज्).

प्रगॄ प्र-गॄ (see rt. 1. गॄ), cl. 9. P. A.
-गृणाति, -गृणीते, -गरितुम्, -गरीतुम्, to announce,
praise, extol, celebrate.
प्रगे प्र-गे. See under प्र-गम्, col. 1.

प्रगै प्र-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to
begin to sing, sing of, sing, celebrate; to sound,
resound.
प्र-गातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a singer, excellent singer.

प्र-गाथ, अस्, m. a strophe, a combination of
two verses (viz. of a Bṛhatī or Kakubh followed
by a Sato-bṛhatī which by an intermixture of the
several Pādas is changed into a triplet); (अस्), m.,
N. of a man with the patronymics Kāṇva and
Ghaura, the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda

-54; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the
hymns of the eighth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda.

प्रागाथ प्रागाथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-गाथ),
[]
belonging to the Pragāthas, i. e. to the eighth
Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda; (अस्), m. a patronymic
of Kali; of Bharga; of Haryata.
प्र-गायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, singing, beginning to sing.

प्र-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung; one who has begun
to sing, singing; resonant with singing, vocal;
(अम्), n. song; a sing-song or drawling recitation
(regarded as a fault).

प्र-गीति, इस्, f. a kind of metre, containing 30 +
29 syllabic instants.

प्रग्रथन प्र-ग्रथन, अम्, n. the act of
connecting or stringing together, intertwining.

प्रग्रह् प्र-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति,
गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to hold forth, hold out, stretch
forth; to offer; to seize, grasp, clutch, take hold of,
take; to receive, accept; to draw up, stop; to draw
towards one's self, unite with; to give a friendly
reception to, act in a friendly manner towards,
favour; to keep separate or isolated (as words &c.
not subjected to the rules of Sandhi): Caus. -ग्रा-
हयति, -यितुम्, to receive, accept.

प्र-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, held in front, held out;
received, accepted, admitted; pronounced separately
without observing the usual rules of Sandhi [cf. 1. प्र-
गृह्य]; collected, strung together (?).
—प्रगृहीत-
पद, अस्, m., scil. सन्धि, a suspension of Sandhi
in which the vowels remain unaltered.

1. प्र-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or accepted,
to be admitted; (in grammar) to be taken or pro-
nounced separately, not subject to the rules of Sandhi
or euphony (as the final ई, ऊ, and ए of the dual
terminations whether of nouns, pronouns, or verbs,
e. g. कवी एतौ, ‘these two poets;’ बन्धू एतौ,
‘these two relations’).

2. प्र-गृह्य, ind. having taken or grasped, car-
rying away with; with.

प्र-गृह्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being taken or
seized.

प्र-ग्रह, अस्, m. holding in front, holding
forth, holding out, stretching forth; taking, taking
or laying hold of, grasping, clutching, seizing (e. g.
अङ्ग-प्˚, the seizing of the limbs [by a demon],
pain in the limbs); the seizing or grasping of the
sun or moon, beginning of an eclipse [cf. ग्रह];
kind or friendly reception, kindness, favour; a rein,
bridle, rope or halter for horses, lash, thong, whip,
scourge; the cord or string suspending a balance; a
guide, leader, ruler; a ray of light; a prisoner,
captive, either man or beast in confinement; bind-
ing; taming, breaking (a horse); the arm; a species
of plant, Cassia Fistula; (in grammar) a vowel not
subject to the rules of Sandhi; epithet of a particular
sacrificial rite (more fully written प्रग्रह-होम);
an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
—प्रग्रह-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, (at the end of a comp.) having seized,
holding; giving a friendly reception, receiving kindly,
obliging, kind.

प्र-ग्राह, अस्, m. seizing, taking, taking up,
bearing, carrying; a rein; the string of a balance.
—प्रग्राह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the string of
a balance.

प्र-ग्रहण, अम्, n. taking, seizing, holding,
assuming; shutting up, confining; the seizure of
sun and moon, i. e. the commencement of an eclipse;
[]
offering; a rein, bridle; a check, restraint; the being
a leader or guide.

प्रग्रीव प्र-ग्रीव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a window,
lattice, balcony (‘projecting like a neck,’ cf. ग्रीवा);
a summer-house, pleasure-house; a building on the
top of a palace, a painted turret; a wooden balus-
trade or fence round a building; a stable; the top
of a tree.

प्रग्लै प्र-ग्लै, cl. 1. P. -ग्लायति, -ग्लातुम्,
to fade or wither away: Caus. -ग्लापयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to fade or wither away.
प्र-ग्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearied, fatigued, exhausted.
प्रागपम् प्राग्-अपम्, &c. See under प्राञ्च्.

प्रागल्भ्य प्रागल्भ्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-गल्-
भ), boldness, confidence; resoluteness, determina-
tion; pride, arrogance, effrontery; pomp, parade,
rank; proficiency.
—प्रागल्भ्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessed of confidence, bold; vain, proud.

प्रागहि प्रागहि, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a
teacher.

प्रागहीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or referring to
Prāgahi.

प्रागाथिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the eighth
Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda.

प्रागार प्रागार, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a
building, a house; a principal building (?).
प्रागाह्निक प्रागाह्निक. See under प्राञ्च्.

प्राग्र प्राग्र (प्र-अग्˚), अम्, n. the highest
point, summit.
—प्राग्र-सर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, going
at the head, foremost, first, best.
—प्राग्र-हर, अस्,
ई, अम्, taking the best share, chief, principal.
प्राग्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, chief, principal, most excellent.

प्राग्राट प्राग्राट, अम्, n. thin coagulated
milk.
प्रागिवीय (fr. प्राग् इव), see Pāṇ.
प्राग्घितीय (fr. प्राग्घितात्), see Pāṇ.

प्राग्दिशीय (fr. प्राग् दिशः), see Scholiast on
Pāṇ.
प्राग्दीव्यतीय (fr. प्राग् दीव्यतः), see Pāṇ.
प्राग्धितीय, a wrong reading for प्राग्घितीय.
प्र-ग्रहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, taking the reins.
